cases.title: Finds the lastn N+1 with a measurement and proposes the set-based patch
EXERCISE-INTRODUCED: frappe.db.count per row in a roster endpoint is an N+1

input.patch:
--- a/sample-app/spice_lite/spice_lite/api/fhir.py
+++ b/sample-app/spice_lite/spice_lite/api/fhir.py
@@ -185,3 +185,10 @@
 
 	log_access("lastn", "SL Observation", [r["id"] for r in results], result_count=len(results))
 	return bundle(results)
+
+
+@frappe.whitelist(methods=["GET"])
+def encounter_counts(country: str):
+	# EXERCISE-INTRODUCED defect for performance-review perf-02
+	rows = frappe.get_list("SL Patient", filters={"country": country}, pluck="name")
+	return {name: frappe.db.count("SL Encounter", {"patient": name}) for name in rows}

cases.notes: The second expected finding is the Postgres index trap: SL Encounter.patient and SL Patient.country have no index on test.localhost (KNOWN_DEFECTS.md D-6).
